entities.summary: Croatian Sign Language is a sign language of the deaf community in Croatia. It has in the past been regarded as a dialect of Yugoslav Sign Language, although the dialectical diversity of the former Yugoslavia has not been assessed. Croatian Sign Language is a modern language.
